lines.text: Moses saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, struck him down, and hid his body in the sand.
When Pharaoh heard what Moses had done, he sought to kill him, and Moses fled and settled in the land of Moab.
Shepherds drove away the priest of Midian's seven daughters at the well, so Moses rose up and watered their flock.
Reuel told his daughters to invite Moses to eat, and he gave his daughter Rebekah to Moses in marriage.
After the king of Egypt died, the Israelites cried out, and God heard their groaning and remembered His covenant.
